design.prompt:
A full-body character design of a cultist seer, to be built into a 3D game model. Front view, standing in a T-pose: arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height, palms down, fingers slightly apart, legs slightly apart, feet flat. Empty hands: no weapon, no instrument, nothing carried or slung on the back. A gaunt older man with a grey-streaked beard in a charcoal-black (not pure black) hooded robe of coarse wool that reaches his ankles, a faded rust-brown woven stole hanging from his shoulders, and a rope belt hung with small dull bronze charms. A broad band of ash-white paint is smeared across his eyes from temple to temple; the face is clearly visible inside the hood. Leather sandals. Ancient Bronze Age Near East: no medieval, Roman or Greek details.

Style: match the reference image's painting exactly: hand-painted grim dark-fantasy concept art, matte, gritty and aged, visible brushwork, earthy desaturated palette of charcoal wool, faded rust-brown, ash white and dull bronze. Use the reference only for painting style, palette and material treatment; do not copy its scene or composition.

Lighting: soft, even, neutral overcast light from the front. No firelight, no colored light, no cast shadows, no dramatic highlights or rim light, so the true colors of every material are visible.

Framing: a single character, centered, entirely in frame head to toe with margin on all sides, on a plain light grey background. No text, labels, UI, ground plane or other objects.

replaces.why: Combat Idle held the staff level like a spear; Axe Stance ends holding it upright.

superseded_why: The auto-rig placed the spine and knee joints outside the body under the loose clothing (spine joints zig-zagging up to 16 cm front to back), so every clip bent the lower back the wrong way. Re-rigging the same mesh reproduced the same joints. Its design image is kept as the identity reference for the redesign.
